decisions.notes: Low muted olive turf, spaced short bunchgrass and a quiet interior; whole silhouette and fixed ground mask retained. Inspected raw source, native1x, nearest4x and mixed-repeat with original base. Complete padded silhouette, hard alpha, registered 56x64 footprint and restrained material identity. Original base remains brighter in several families, especially desert/taiga; this slice reduces repetition, not a seamless biome-transition or completed value-unification pass. Static terrain only. In-game acceptance follows publication.
